sample: E = square arms of the 2026-10-02 indicator-levels study ($10+, 09:40-15:30): ai_reports/indicator_levels/rows.json + ext.pkl. Same SIP sessions as order_block_gate / sr_exit_resist. Outcome per arm = gross15 (15-min close/entry − 1) and net15 = gross15 − 0.20% (the locked $10+ cost). Opens kept as-is.
halves: chronological: first half of sample days vs second half
room: at the decision close, % from price up to the bottom of the nearest charted resistance above (unbroken bearish OB or bullish breaker), known point-in-time among charted last 3 per side. No resistance above => room = 0 (treated as under the floor).
sizing_primary: weight w = 0.5 when room < 0.40%, else w = 1.0 (half-size vs full). Contribution of an arm = w * return.
sizing_info: w = 0 when room < floor else 1.0 (skip vs full); floor 0.60% with half-size
control: equal full size: w = 1.0 on every same open (contribution = return). Same arms, same outcomes; only the weight differs.
book_metric: mean contribution in bp of full-size notional: signal = mean(w * gross_bp), control = mean(gross_bp). Lift = signal − control. Net lift uses net_bp the same way. Measured RT spread for the pass bar = mean(w_signal) * 20 bp (the flat 0.20% cost scaled by the sized book's mean weight — measured from the charged cost model, not invented).
pass: in BOTH chronological halves: (mean(w*gross) − mean(gross)) > measured RT of that half (mean(w)*20 bp), AND >= 50 arms per half. Also report net after costs (mean(w*net) and equal-size mean(net)). Fewer than 50 -> UNDERPOWERED. Any PASS = PENDING SKEPTIC REVIEW (not a live size change; SIP ≠ IEX).
information_only: skip vs full (w in {0,1}) at floor 0.40%
share of arms under the floor, mean room, mean w
